title: Commercial Office Cleaning quote, real prices, under a minute
jobDescription:
Commercial office clean in Richmond. Weekly service, every Friday afternoon. Total approximate floor area two hundred square metres.

Scope of works:
- Open Plan Office (one hundred and fifty square metres): General surface wipe-down of all desks (ten desks), filing cabinets (five units), and common area surfaces. Vacuum all carpeted floors and mop hard floors (ten square metres). Empty and reline ten small desk bins.
- Private Offices (two rooms, fifteen square metres each): General surface wipe-down of desks (one per room) and vacuum carpet.
- Kitchen/Breakroom (twenty square metres): Clean and sanitise benchtops, sink, microwave interior and exterior, and exterior of fridge. Mop hard floors. Empty and reline two kitchen bins.
- Bathrooms (two rooms): Sanitisation of two toilets, two sinks, and two mirrors. Mop hard floors. Empty and reline two small bins.
- Consumables Supply: Weekly check and refill of two soap dispensers, two paper towel dispensers, and two toilet roll dispensers (two rolls per dispenser). Supply of all cleaning materials.
workingDetail: General surface cleaning, Vacuum and mop all floors, Kitchen and breakroom cleaning, Bathroom sanitisation
